senses.gloss: to collect, gather; to cover, shelter, bring home.
units: B. Kam. VI, 1 הכּוֹנס צאן לדיר he who takes the flock into the stall; a. fr.—כ׳ משקה to absorb liquids through pores, opp. to הוציא to let liquids escape through pores.
<cite ref="Niddah 49a:24">Nidd. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>יביא … אם כָּנְסָה וכ׳</he> get a tub full of water and put the pot in, if it draws water &c.

Kel. X, 8 היו בכוֹנֵס משקה (sub. נקובין) if the vessels were so porous as to be called absorbers of liquids. Nidd. l. c. כיצד … לידע אם ניקב בכונס משקה how do we examine to find out whether a vessel is porous to the extent of absorbing liquids? (v. supra); a. fr.—Esp. to take a woman home, to consummate a marriage by conducting a woman to one’s house, to wed, v. אֵירוּסִין a. נִישּׂוּאִין.
<cite ref="Ketubot 3b:1">Keth. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>וברביעי כּוֹנְסָהּ</he> and on the fourth day of the week he weds her.

<cite ref="Ketubot 3b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ומסכנה ואילך נהגו … לִכְנוֹס וכ׳</he> and from the days of persecution … the people adopted the custom to wed on the third day; … <he>ובשני לא יִכְנוֹס</he> but on the second day one must not marry.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 4:11:10">Y. Yeb. IV, 6ᵇ</cite> <he>כְּנָסָהּ ולא וכ׳</he> he took her to his home but did not touch her &c.; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="K00044"><he>כְּנוּסָה</he></cite>.
Y. Sot. II, 18ᵇ top שומרת יבם וכ׳ neither while waiting for the yabam nor after having been taken to his house.

senses.gloss: (of a sore) [to gather,] to grow smaller, to contract, opp. פשה.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 4:7">Neg. IV, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 2:6">Tosef. ib. II, 6</cite>; Sifra Thazr., Neg., Par. 2, ch. II; a. e.

senses.gloss: (archit.) to recede, to form a settle or recess in a wall.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 3:1">Midd. III, 1</cite> <he>עלה אמה וכ׳ אמה</he> (the altar) rose one cubit and then receded one cubit; <cite ref="Menachot 97b">Men. 97ᵇ</cite>.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 7:2:4">Y. Erub. VII, 24ᵇ</cite> bot. (of an inclined plane) <he>עולה אמה וכוֹנֵס שלש</he> it rises vertically one cubit, while the incline measures three cubits, v. <cite ref="K00486"><he>כִּיבּוּשׁ</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <cite ref="K00844"><he>כָּנוּס</he></cite>, f. <cite ref="K00044"><he>כְּנוּסָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 1:10">Tosef. Erub. I, 10</cite> <he>כותל שצידו אחד כ׳ מחבירו וכ׳</he> a wall which is more receding on one side than on the other, either the inner wall being even &c.; <cite ref="Eruvin 9b">Erub. 9ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 15a">15ᵃ</cite>; (Y. ib. 19ᵇ top <he>כותל הנכנס</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 1:1:10">Y. Succ. I, 52ᵃ</cite> <he>אפי׳ כנוסה כמה</he> even if the reduction be ever so large.

senses.gloss: to be brought in, to enter, opp. יצא; to assemble, meet.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 65a">Erub. 65ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="O00257"><he>סוֹד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 15b">Ib. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ ויוצא</he> is easily passed in and out.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 9:7">Kel. IX, 7</cite> <he>מלא … נ׳</he> when a piece of the size … can be passed, <he>לא נ׳</he> when it cannot pass (exactly fitting in). Y. Erub. I, 18ᶜ bot. <he>אין … לִיכָּנֵס וכ׳</he> it is not the habit of man to enter through one door and leave through another.—
<cite ref="Chullin 3a">Ḥull. 3ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>יוצא ונ׳</he> superintending by going in and out.
<cite ref="Shabbat 137b:6">Sabb. 137ᵇ</cite> <he>כשם שנ׳ … יִכָּנס וכ׳</he> as he (the child) has been entered into the covenant, so may he be introduced to the study of the Law &c.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 101a:11">Snh. 101ᵃ</cite> <he>נִכְנְסוּ תלמידיו וכ׳</he> his pupils came together to visit him. Tosef. Ber. VII (VI), 19, a. e. <he>לא יִכָּנֵס אדם להר וכ׳</he> one must not enter the Temple mount &c.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 1:3">Meg. I, 3</cite> <he>מקום שנִכְנָסִין וכ׳</he> a place where the country people are in the habit of assembling on Mondays &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to form a recess or settle. Y. Erub. I, 19ᵇ top, v. supra.
to be married, v. supra. Y. Yeb. IV, 6ᵇ הִיכָּנְסִי וכ׳ be my wife and raise thy sister’s children; Koh. R. to IX, 9; a. fr.

to gather, collect. Tosef. Ber. VII (VI), 24 בשעת המְכַנְּסִין … כַּנֵּס when people collect (learning), scatter, when they scatter (are indifferent), gather in (withdraw); v. בְּדַר; Ber. 63ᵃ המכניסים (read: המְכַנְּ׳, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9).
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 17">Ex. R. s. 17</cite>, beg. <he>שכִּינְּסָן מעל הארץ</he> which (waters) he gathered from upon the land.

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3">Deut. R. s. 3</cite> <he>כִּינְּסָה את בניה</he> she assembled her children; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְכוּנָּס</he>, f. <he>מְכוּנֶּסֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְכוּנָּסִין</he>, <he>מְכוּנָּסוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 21a">Erub. 21ᵃ</cite> (<cite ref="M01199"><he>מים</he></cite>) <cite ref="M00001"><he>מ׳</he></cite> collected water, opp. <he>מים חיים</he>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 70:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXX</cite> <he>הרי הצאן מכ׳</he> the flock is gathered again.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 4:3">Neg. IV, 3</cite> <he>במ׳</he> when the hairs on the leprous spot are close together, opp. <he>מפוזר</he>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to bring in, to lay in, store up; to introduce, pass; to initiate.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:3">Lev. R. s. 9</cite> <he>הִכְנִיסוֹ לביתו</he> he invited him to his house.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20:14">Ex. R. s. 20</cite> <he>אם אני מַכְנִיסָן וכ׳</he> if I lead them now into the land.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20">Ib.</cite> <he>ה׳ יינו וכ׳</he> he stored his wine in the cellar.
<cite ref="Menachot 97a:10">Men. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>ומכניס קנה וכ׳</he> and passes a tube under it.
<cite ref="Shabbat 118b">Sabb. 118ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ ידו וכ׳</he> put his hand under his belt.

<cite ref="Shabbat 118b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>מַכְנִיסֵי שבת</he> who usher the Sabbath in (with prayer). Ib. 137ᵇ <he>להַכְנִיסוֹ בבריתו וכ׳</he> to initiate him into the covenant &c. (v. supra). Y. Yeb. I, 3ᵃ bot. <he>הרי אתם מַכְנִיסִין ראשי וכ׳</he> you want me to put my head between two great mountains. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 6 <he>לא מוציא ולא מַכְנִיס</he> neither lets escape nor receives, v. <cite ref="N00309"><he>נוֹד</he></cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Taanit 27b:6">Taan. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>מִתְכַּנְּסִין לבה״כ</he> meet at the synagogue.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39">Gen. R. s. 39</cite>, a. e. <he>אם מתכנסין כל וכ׳</he> if all human beings were to join for creating &c.; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3">Cant. R. to I, 3</cite> <he>מִתְכַּנְּשִׁין</he>. Mekh. B’shall. s. 6 <he>אין הגליות מִתְכַּנְּסוֹת וכ׳</he> the diaspora will be reunited only as a reward for faith; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12">Gen. R. s. 12</cite>, beg. <he>מתכנסין ויוצאין</he>; (Koh. R. to II, 12 <he>נכנסין</he>) they go in and out.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 1:6">Neg. I, 6</cite> <he>נִתְכַּנְּסָה</he> the sore gathered.
